description: This file defines the `OrderProvider` class, which manages order-related state and operations in a Flutter application. It handles placing orders and fetching existing orders from an API service, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: OrderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the order state, includes methods for placing and fetching orders, and notifies listeners on changes.

methods.name: OrderProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with an ApiService instance.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronously places an order with the provided items and fulfillment, updates loading state, and refreshes the orders list upon success.

methods.name: fetchOrders
methods.description: Fetches the list of orders from the API and updates internal state if successful.
